text:
Introduce me to the unknown woman

you become at the moment

when the poem insinuates itself

like an insect between your fingers,

and, sharing you with the wolves,

turns your breasts into swallows.

Are you mine, rebellious woman,

whom I see transformed into stone?

Look at me now, I am your master

and I show you infinity here:

at every step we take

we must be born again before the verb

that joins obedience and adventure.

I rebuild your new arm

and rebuild your figure,

but this movement carries us

to the bottom of our blood

—children harried by a white vertigo

and whose dream is worth scarcely

the syllable that is dying.

translation.title: Hesitation
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the unstable power-play and the poem's movement toward language as danger.
